items.title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
items.summary: Britain's foreign secretary accuses settlers of carrying out the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians, as Israel responds by shutting the UK consulate in East Jerusalem.
